# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite on Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU backends on Skia m152. It also adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback and a Silk.NET Vulkan helper, strengthens native-memory lifetimes, and improves several managed hot paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152, rolls VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, and preserves the Vulkan allocator fallback used by SkiaSharp callers. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))
- **Upstream rendering stability improved** — Includes m151 font-rendering and Ganesh stability fixes, including a correction that prevents stale texture data after pending render tasks fail to flush. ([#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backends added** — Exposes contexts, recorders, recordings, textures, and Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backend contexts for Skia's next-generation GPU architecture, including browser WebGPU through Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback added** — Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface, callback-scoped SKImageReadPixelsResult access, rescale options, copy-out helpers, and GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion for deferred Ganesh work. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration added** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET convenience package for cross-platform Vulkan contexts and makes the parameterless GRVkExtensions constructor public. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Borrowed native memory stays alive** — Region iterators now retain their source SKRegion, while SKPixmap subset and With* results retain their ultimate pixel owner, preventing use-after-free failures. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Failed raster image creation no longer leaks** — SKImage.Create(SKImageInfo) now frees its unmanaged pixel buffer when native raster-image creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKData.SaveTo writes more efficiently** — Span-capable targets now write the native buffer directly to the destination stream, removing the intermediate buffer copy and roughly doubling measured throughput. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Native wrapper creation avoids repeated reflection** — Caches each wrapper type's skip-registration decision so frequently used HandleDictionary paths no longer repeat Type.IsAssignableFrom checks. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **Managed marshalling and uniform setup allocate less** — Null-terminated encoded text no longer needs an intermediate string, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its name lookup map to the known uniform count. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Caller-supplied fonts render on Nano Server** — The Nano Server native asset now uses bundled FreeType, allowing typefaces loaded through SKTypeface.FromStream, FromData, or FromFile to render without DirectWrite. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

This preview co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 rather than 14.2.1.1, with no HarfBuzz binding changes in this scope.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Moves to Skia m152 with upstream font and Ganesh fixes; adds Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan integration, and Nano Server font support. Fixes iterator, pixmap, and raster-allocation lifetimes while improving SKData.SaveTo, wrapper creation, text marshalling, and uniform setup. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
